name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (2026-07-04) is a major release with 238 commits introducing Connect Knowledge (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox integration), a 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), per-room agent Channels, a Telegram remote-control gateway, and a 'Manila Arc' borderless UI redesign. Security improvements include PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt and login rate-limiting. v0.6.0 introduces a self-update mechanism, with future releases published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases. Notable breaking changes include a shift from hash-based to clean-path routing and an on-disk rename of the team-chat directory from `.slack` to `.channels`.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits, and v0.6.0 followed shortly after
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt, login rate-limiting, mobile browser and reverse-proxy support

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron. Old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser, but the canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from `.slack` to `.channels`, scoped per room.
v0.6.0: Cabinet now updates itself via a new updater; future releases are published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases rather than the original repository.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers much richer document management with OCR and tagging but is significantly heavier and more complex to self-host than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a full-featured document management system with workflows and permissions, but requires more resources and setup compared to Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document organization and OCR but has a steeper setup curve and heavier footprint than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud Files
alternatives.review: Nextcloud Files offers broad file management and collaboration features but is a much larger platform with significant overhead compared to Cabinet's minimal footprint.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and self-hostable but focuses on connecting to various storage backends rather than acting as a standalone document cabinet.
